Title: [JOURNEY] Customer profile to All orders to filtered list to open own order and back
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:SR_REP_PRIMARY]

Fixtures pinned live for this run: @td(ORDER_REP_PLACED.number) (TechFlow, placed by this rep), @td(ORDER_BUYER_PLACED.number) (TechFlow, placed by a buyer -- same org, different author), @td(ORDER_NOT_SERVED.number) (Acme-EU -- an org the rep does NOT serve, must never appear). The two TechFlow orders differ ONLY in who placed them, so a scope failure cannot be explained away by org-scoping instead of authorship.

[ACT] click the row/customer-name cell for @td(ORG_TECHFLOW.name)
[WAIT] customer profile page rendered
[KEY] record the profile URL and the breadcrumb segment text list

[ACT] click the "All orders" link inside the Recent Orders block
[WAIT] navigation settles
--- SCREEN: Customer-Scoped Orders List ---
[KEY] record the landing URL, the page heading text, and the full breadcrumb segment list
[WAIT] the order grid has rendered at least one row
[KEY] record every rendered order number and, where a Customer column is rendered, every rendered Customer value
--- SCREEN: Filter, Sort, Page ---
[ACT] apply a status filter for a status present among this customer's orders
[WAIT] the grid re-renders filtered
[ACT] sort by Date
[WAIT] the grid re-renders sorted
[ACT] navigate to page 2 of the result
[WAIT] the grid re-renders page 2
[KEY] record the rendered row set after each of the three actions above
--- SCREEN: Open Order Placed By The Rep ---
[ACT] clear the filter
[WAIT] the grid re-renders unfiltered
[ACT] return to page 1
[WAIT] page 1 renders
[ACT] open the row for @td(ORDER_REP_PLACED.number)
[WAIT] navigation settles on the order's destination page
[KEY] record the destination URL and which of Pay now / Reorder are enabled
--- SCREEN: Open Order Placed By A Buyer ---
[ACT] navigate back to the customer-scoped orders list
[ACT] open the row for @td(ORDER_BUYER_PLACED.number)
[WAIT] navigation settles on the order's destination page
[KEY] record the destination URL and the full set of enabled action controls
--- SCREEN: Return Via Breadcrumb ---
[ACT] click the customer segment of the breadcrumb
[WAIT] navigation settles
[KEY] record the resulting URL and whether the profile's Orders context is still active

[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on the page under test
